Not quite yet. The ten items accurately summarize what we settled, but several important parts of the app haven’t been explored:

- Clicking a bookmark should open its original web page.
- I need to select multiple bookmarks and add or remove tags, mark them read or unread, archive them, or delete them together. I should also be able to apply an action to every bookmark matching the current search or filter, not merely those loaded on screen.
- I want a preserved local copy of a saved page. For a PDF, preserve the PDF itself; for a normal page, keep a self-contained page copy. I’d also like the option to save a copy through the Internet Archive.
- I want to save a useful combination of search text plus included or excluded tags as a reusable collection.
- I need to import existing browser bookmarks and export my library in the common bookmark HTML format, retaining titles, tags, and original save dates.
- Along with the remembered default sort, I want personal display choices such as font size and how many items are shown.

Please explore and settle these behaviors before implementation begins.
